qoi: convergence order of the error on a fixed probe grid
equation: -div(a(u) grad u) = f, with the coefficient depending on the solution itself
coefficients: a(u) = 1 + u**2/2. The problem is NONLINEAR; use a Newton solver and converge it to a relative residual of 1e-10 or smaller at every level.
element: Lagrange P1 (first-order, continuous) elements on triangles
mesh_text: uniform meshes of the unit square with N = 8, 16, 32, 64 elements per side (h = 1/N), all four levels
